versos.e: Meets Jacob at a well Ge 29:9-12
Jacob serves Laban for an additional seven years to obtain her as his wife Ge 29:15-30
Her grief in consequence of her sterility; gives her maid, to Jacob in order to obtain children in her own name Ge 30:1-8,15,22-34
Steals the household images (teraphim, legal deed) of her father Ge 31:4,14-19,33-35
